about: Where the build of S1 (the countryside, the scroll's start) departs from the scroll map, each with its reason (map/BUILDING.md rule 7). moves: shift an entity (tools/map_layout.mjs applies them to layout.json); how: an entity built other than as its kind's default, or a ground entity given a rise (the countryside-ground pilot); unbuilt: mapped entities not built yet, with the reason and who decided; edges: the walkable area's sides; boats: the boat kit's options per boat. Sizes the strokes can't give are marked choice: in blender/countryside_scene.py and blender/kit_countryside.py and listed in sections/countryside/notes.md. Edited by the S1 Run 2 workers (ground/builder, kit, casting), each only for its own entities.

S1.ani.donkey_charcoal_36745.why: casting (make_people.py; cast.json train): the charcoal train set out at real size along S1.road.main, its path. Five donkeys 1.49 m long and 0.8 m across the panniers, painted overlapping in a 4.7 m file, stand 1.9 m apart in their painted order, D5 leading east, in alternate lanes 0.69 m apart (-0.41 / +0.28 m off the centre line), so people.js never has a donkey steer round the one ahead.
